name: AI Affiliate Product Video (Foto Telegram -> Gemini Vision + TTS + Remotion -> Telegram)

parameters.text: 📸 Kirim *foto produk* ke bot ini (boleh tambah caption nama/harga/keunggulan produk) untuk langsung dibuatkan video promosi affiliate otomatis!
⏳ Foto produk diterima! AI sedang menganalisis produk, membuat skrip affiliate, voiceover Gemini TTS, dan merender video promosi 9:16...

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "jobId": "{{ $('Parse Affiliate Script').item.json.jobId }}",
  "title": "{{ $('Parse Affiliate Script').item.json.title }}",
  "caption": "{{ $('Parse Affiliate Script').item.json.caption }}",
  "themeColor": "{{ $('Parse Affiliate Script').item.json.themeColor }}",
  "scenes": {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse Affiliate Script').item.json.scenes) }},
  "productImageBase64": "{{ $('Parse Affiliate Script').item.json.productImageBase64 }}",
  "productImageMimeType": "{{ $('Parse Affiliate Script').item.json.productImageMimeType }}",
  "audioBase64": "{{ $json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].inlineData.data }}",
  "audioMimeType": "{{ $json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].inlineData.mimeType || 'audio/L16;rate=24000' }}"
}
